# AI Daily Radar

> A bilingual (English and Simplified Chinese) daily briefing on AI and the frontier tech around it: chips and compute, robots and self-driving, EVs and energy (including Tesla), space, science and biotech, and tech industry and policy. Each story credits and links its original publisher, carries a status label (Rumored, Planned, Announced, Demonstrated, Released, Available) and separates verified facts from unconfirmed claims. Written with AI assistance and run by Ying Shi.
